source_message.text:
Brother,

Plan around the timing first: **DEADLINE: Thursday.** Every clip must reach me by Thursday morning—not Thursday night—because I have to review and approve all of them before they go live Friday. Anything I do not have by then does not get posted this week.

The big update is that you now have access to the B-roll footage, which can take your clips to the next level.

B-roll link: <https://emberframe.example/drive/folders/campaign-assets-4827>

Using this B-roll footage alongside Arden's long-form YouTube videos, create **12 perfect clips**. Every clip must follow these rules exactly:

- Run 70 to 85 seconds minimum
- Capture a complete moment, with the full lesson or story presented from start to finish
- Integrate B-roll naturally in support of the message, never as random footage
- Use white text only, with no colored fonts or text effects
- Keep the editing clean and simple, without heavy animations or flashy transitions
- Keep background music at low volume and never louder than Arden's voice
- Make each clip standalone so that even someone unfamiliar with Arden can watch it and understand it completely

Move fast. To strengthen each moment rather than merely fill space, use the B-roll only where it adds power to the message.

Submit your 12 clips as a Google Drive folder link, use your name for the folder title, and set the folder so anyone with the link can view it.

Because these are the first real clips going live, make every one perfect.

Darius

value_updates.background_music_volume: low and never louder than Arden's voice

I hired you because I saw something in you. This is your time to show it, so go make something great.

Darius
